faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about our workflow, pricing, and support before getting started.
faq.more_desc: Our team is available 24/7 to answer your inquiries and provide personalized advice.
faq.q1: How long does the free demo take?
faq.a1: The demo is ready within 24 to 72 hours of your request. We build a complete design based on your brand so you can inspect your website before paying a dime.
faq.q2: How long does final delivery take?
faq.a2: Final delivery takes between 3 days to a week depending on requirements. Complex online stores may take a bit longer for payment and shipping integration.
faq.q3: Is there any commitment before seeing the demo?
faq.a3: Zero commitment. The demo is 100% free — review it, proceed if you love it, and if not, there is no obligation whatsoever.
faq.q4: Who owns the domain and hosting?
faq.a4: You own the domain and hosting completely in your name. We set them up and hand over all credentials to you.
faq.q5: What happens after the website is delivered?
faq.a5: After handover, we provide continuous technical support based on your plan. Any updates, fixes, or inquiries — our team is with you.
faq.q6: Can I update the website myself?
faq.a6: Yes! We provide an intuitive dashboard where you can edit content, add products, or change images without any coding skills. We can also handle updates for you.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.data_collection_text: We only collect data voluntarily submitted via contact forms (name, phone, business type) to communicate regarding demo requests and services. We never sell or share your data with 3rd parties.
privacy.cookies_text: We use essential cookies to measure performance and enhance user experience. You can manage your preferences at any time.
privacy.security_text: We utilize encryption and Row Level Security (RLS) via Supabase. Your data is encrypted and accessible only by authorized engineers for your project.
privacy.rights_text: You retain full rights to inspect, modify, or erase your data records anytime by messaging us via WhatsApp or email.
privacy.updates_text: We may update this policy to comply with emerging security standards. Revisions will be published promptly on this page.
